name: Velo Client Addons (Experimental)
description: Optional experimental extras for Velo Client, meant for singleplayer and minigames: Fly Boat, Cinematic Camera, Sound Radar, Auto Tunnel Miner, Auto Eat, Entity Finder, Storage Finder, Ender Chest Farmer and Auto Excavator. Some of these automate gameplay - check a server's rules before using them in multiplayer.
